sentences.text:
Shri Y.D. Yadav - Government Advocate for respondent/St
Heard on admission.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A.No.11511/2025 an application under Section 430 of B.N.S.S. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellants.
The appellants have been convicted under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 3 years each with fine of Rs.2000/- each with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
Thus, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellants may be suspended.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State on the other hand has opposed the application.
Considering the short sentence and coupled with the fact that the final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, I deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the appellants.

Subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellants is hereby suspended and it is 2 CRA-4858-2025 directed that the appellants be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees fifteen thousand only)
each with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the concerning trial court on 11.08.2025 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by the trial court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
